sources.state_demand: Merit India (meritindia.in) state SLDC demand pulls, mirrored by github.com/vanga/india-power-generation. The mirror declares no licence and publishes no terms of use, so the data is used as scraped public figures with attribution.
sources.national_hourly_2019_2024: github.com/2003DIVYA/India-Power-Grid-Demand-Forecasting hourlyLoadDataIndia.csv (secondary scrape; provenance unverified upstream, used only as context and cross-check)
sources.weather: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive, hourly, Asia/Kolkata, no key required

caveats: No city-level measurements exist in any accessible source; the game's city demand is state model output scaled by labelled metro share constants in config/state_registry.json.
The two national sources disagree by ~4% on overlapping daily means, so absolute values are indicative rather than official CEA statistics.
Variable-date festival holidays are hand-curated approximations, not an official calendar.
Merit India Demand for IND occasionally exceeds published all-India peak records; outliers are flagged, not silently removed.
